mission: Build Context Fabric Lite P1: deterministic artifact inventory with explicit durable-ID precedence/path fallback, sparse explicit reference graph, exact+lexical retrieval, mandatory hard closure for authority/privacy/freshness/contradictions, context compiler and durable receipt payload, with no embeddings, pgvector or generated-prose dependency in P1.
useful_delta: Implemented the first runnable deterministic Context Fabric Lite P1 candidate. It inventories repository artifacts with durable-ID-before-path identity, derives only explicit sparse reference edges, applies privacy before ranking, compiles exact+lexical candidates, builds a non-prunable mandatory closure for governing/required/dependency/contradiction evidence, fails closed on stale source-head/index mismatch or an oversized hard closure, and emits auditable Working Set + context receipt payloads with per-stage selection reasons, hashes, omissions, authority labels, contradictions, freshness and AUTOMATED_CONTEXT_COMPILER provenance. The build/compile CLIs produce disposable derived projections and do not require vectors, a database or generated prose summaries.

evidence.test_environment: isolated local Node 22 candidate-byte harness; published main blob SHAs were re-read and matched the exact pre-tested blobs
covered_falsifiers: same inputs/source head build identical index hash and deep-equal projections
explicit durable artifact identity survives rename while path fallback remains fallback
only explicit dependency/contradiction refs become sparse graph edges
PRIVATE artifact is excluded before ranking despite very high lexical relevance
mandatory closure survives a soft maxFiles budget and records the budget overrun
reverse-declared contradiction evidence is pulled into mandatory closure and surfaced
stale expected source head fails closed
receipt records hashes, omissions, candidate counts, stage reasons and automated compiler provenance
content mutation changes deterministic index hash
mandatory closure exceeding hard cap fails closed instead of dropping authority evidence
P1 source has no pgvector/embedding/OpenAI dependency
privacy guard rejects secret-shaped object fields/Bearer authorization without rejecting harmless documentation vocabulary tokens

non_obvious_findings: project_id is not a globally durable artifact identity: multiple artifacts legitimately share a project, so treating it as the artifact ID caused alias collisions. The implementation now uses explicit artifact/run/queue/workstream/chat-object/claim/return IDs first and path identity only as fallback.

A privacy guard that rejects the bare vocabulary token 'password' creates false positives in generated lexical indexes. The guard now rejects secret-shaped serialized fields such as "password": and Bearer authorization shapes while allowing harmless documentation tokens.

Under the live swarm, atomic multi-file CAS publication repeatedly lost a fast-forward race even with no same-path collision. The fallback publication used create-if-absent only on the exclusively claimed paths, never update/force, preserving concurrent unrelated main advances.

source_freshness.note: Public runtime lagged live main during heavy concurrent swarm commits. This return records both identities and does not promote the lagging projection or newest commit by recency alone.

truth_boundary: This RETURN is candidate implementation evidence only. It does not declare Context Fabric globally operational, does not prove a live full-repository scan-efficiency denominator, and does not promote any artifact to Current, Human Accepted or Served. A separate steward/verifier must consume this return under the governing verification/readiness gates.
next_boundary: Run an independent live-repository Context Fabric canary against a pinned checkout/index and measure critical-source recall plus selected-vs-scan file/token reduction.
Persist the automated compiler receipt for that canary before material work and verify stale-head invalidation across an actual main advance.
Only after those gates may a steward consider moving Context Fabric from candidate evidence toward operational use.
